messages:
maria (PM): Quick sync on rollouts UX — primarily the timeline + A/B/canary flows. Pushed a few frames to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/rollouts-redesign
kevin (Design): Skimming frames. Main questions: should we show a compact diff for config changes inline in timeline? and do we expose A/B traffic presets or let users type %? :thinking_face:
alex (Frontend): Inline diff doable but can bloat the timeline. Maybe collapse diffs by default with a "show changes" chevron per node. Presets: show chips (5%, 10%, 25%, 50%) + numeric input; chips quick, input precise.
jamie (Eng-Platform): Backend can return a small `changes_summary` string for each rollout node to render in collapsed view, so frontend doesn't compute diffs. Also can provide a `has_diff` bool for toggling.
olivia (Accessibility): If we show diffs, ensure semantic markup (<pre> for code) and allow toggling with keyboard. For A/B controls, ensure the chips are real radio buttons (not divs) so screen readers announce current selection.
kevin (Design): Good call. UI question: rollback affordance. Option A: inline small "Rollback" link on each node. Option B: single primary rollback action in an expanded details panel. Thoughts?
amaria (PM): Operational preference: inline rollback for dev/staging, but for prod we should surface a clear modal with consequences. The inline link is fine if clicking opens the modal.
alex (Frontend): Makes sense. We'll make the inline CTA a button that opens the modal anchored to that node. Modal will include: target version, diff link, automated checks, and a confirm phrase for prod (type "rollback {version}").
kevin (Design): Timeline interactions: add a vertical scrubber that pins the right-hand details panel to the selected node. Also add a tiny history zoom (last 24h / 7d / all) to control density.
oljivia (typo)
olivia (Accessibility): Scrubber must be keyboard reachable; aria-live updates for the details panel when node changes. Also ensure focus is trapped in rollback modal while open.
jamie (Eng-Platform): API note: we'll add endpoints: GET /rollouts/:id/history?range=24h and POST /rollouts/:id/rollback. Rollback endpoint will accept {reason, require_confirmation}. We'll also include `auto_rollback_policy` field on the rollout resource.
kevin (Design): Copy nits: change "Start canary" to "Launch canary (recommended: 5%)". For A/B toggle use "Run experiment (A vs B)" and show a small help tooltip explaining metric selection.
amaria (PM): Add a short audit field visible in the timeline item: who triggered, note snippet, and link to full audit log. That avoids hunting in other subsystems.
livia (typo)
olivia (Accessibility): Small contrast issue on the experiment badge when used on dark mode. I'll add exact color tokens after Kevin updates frames. Also request: provide non-color status cues (icon + label) and ensure badges have aria-labels like "Experiment running, 50 percent traffic to candidate".
kevin (Design): Will add iconography and update dark mode swatches. Also proposing a tiny inline KPI row under each timeline node: success %, p95 latency, error rate with mini sparklines. Keep them compact and optionally hideable.
alex (Frontend): I can implement sparklines as svg <path> with accessible titles. Need metric payload: {name, value, sparkline_points}. Jamie, can you add that to the history API?
jamie (Eng-Platform): Yup: history nodes will include `metrics_snapshot`: [{name, value, points: []}]. We'll cap points to 30 to keep payloads small. ETA in next deploy.
maria (PM): Final decisions for now: 1) diffs collapsed by default with `changes_summary` in node, 2) inline rollback CTA opens modal (modal required for prod), 3) A/B presets + numeric input, 4) timeline scrubber and zoom, 5) mini-kpis per node (hideable), 6) accessibility: ARIA labels, non-color cues, keyboard scrubbing.
kevin (Design): I'll push updated frames with compact diff placeholder, modal flows, and dark mode fixes by tomorrow morning. Please review in Figma.
design-bot: Design review created for rollouts page (thread 1748123456). Reviewers requested: kevin,olivia,alex.
alex (Frontend): Starting a spike branch: feat/rollouts-timeline-scrubber. I'll stub API responses for now. Will ping when staging preview ready.
jamie (Eng-Platform): I'll post API changelog when endpoints are live.
olivia (Accessibility): I'll run quick keyboard + screen reader pass once staging preview is up. Happy to collaborate on aria strings.
maria (PM): Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers, drop notes here. We'll reconvene next Tue 11am if needed.
